boutiques.name: Map Camera
boutiques.info:
## Map Camera — Shinjuku (Nishi-Shinjuku)

Flagship used-camera specialist, a must-stop for camera hunters. 5 floors of second-hand bodies, lenses and accessories, organized by brand.

**Floors**
- **1F** — Entrance, showcase displays, latest arrivals, staffed information counter.
- **2F** — Used digital cameras (Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, Olympus, Panasonic) sorted by maker.
- **3F** — Used lenses (mirrorless + DSLR) by mount; telephoto and prime sections.
- **4F** — Film cameras, rangefinders, vintage gear, Leica corner, medium format.
- **5F** — Accessories: tripods, bags, filters, flashes, straps; also buying/trade-in counter.

**Hours:** 10:00–20:00 daily (no regular holiday).

**Notes:** Tax-free for tourists (show passport; spend ¥5,000+). Buying counter on 5F — bring ID. Very strong Sony E-mount stock; good place to hunt NEX-7 / α6100 / α6400 bodies.

⚠️ Facade photo is a placeholder — replace `map-camera.jpg` with an on-site photo when available.

boutiques.nameJP: ヨドバシカメラ マルチメディア新宿西口本店
boutiques.info:
## Yodobashi Camera — Shinjuku West Exit (Main Store)

Large multi-floor electronics + camera megastore. Strong on new gear, with a sizable used section. The original Shinjuku camera-retail anchor.

**Floors**
- **B1F–1F** — Mobile, computing, household electronics.
- **2F** — New cameras (Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, OM System), lenses, action cams.
- **3F** — Used cameras & lenses; trade-in/buying counter.
- **5F** — Audio, headphones, watches.
- **8F–9F** — Photo studio, photo printing, passport photos.

**Hours:** 9:30–22:00 daily.

**Notes:** Tax-free counter available (passport, ¥5,000+). Note: Yodobashi has consolidated several former Shinjuku sub-stores into this main multimedia location; some standalone buildings (e.g. the old Film/Repair building) have closed — check current layout before visiting. Good for comparing new α6400 street price against used prices here and at Map Camera.

boutiques.name: Lemonsha Shinjuku
boutiques.info:
## Lemonsha Shinjuku (レモン社 新宿店)

Curated used-camera shop, part of the Naniwa group. Renovated Feb 2021. Single 3rd-floor location — friendly, approachable, good for both beginners and collectors.

**Layout (single floor, 3F)**
- Front — Digital bodies (Sony Alpha, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm), lenses by mount.
- Middle — Vintage film cameras, rangefinders, half-frame; good place to look for Olympus Pen F / Pen FT.
- Back — Bags, tripods, accessories; shooting studio (passport/profile photos).

**Hours:** 10:30–19:30 daily. **Tel:** 03-5909-2333.

**Notes:** Buys and takes consignments. Smaller, more curated than Map Camera — prices sometimes higher but quality graded carefully. Tax-free available. Excellent film-camera selection — strong candidate for finding an Olympus Pen F.

## Kitamura Camera — Shinjuku West Exit (Odakyu HALC)

National-chain used-camera shop inside the Odakyu HALC building. Good trade-in program and reasonable used prices; convenient location steps from the West Exit.

**Floors (within HALC)**
- **2F** — Used digital cameras & lenses, trade-in/buying reception.
- **3F** — Photo printing, albums, accessories, small studio.

**Hours:** 10:00–21:00 daily (check HALC building holidays).

**Notes:** Strong for mid-tier used Sony Alpha bodies (α6000/α6100/α6400) — often competitively priced vs. specialist stores. Online stock check via kitamura.co.jp lets you reserve before visiting. Tax-free available.

boutiques.nameJP: ビックカメラ 新宿東口店
boutiques.info:
## Bic Camera — Shinjuku East Exit (Amt Building)

Large multi-floor electronics store on the east side of the station. Strong new-camera section with frequent bundle/point-back promotions.

**Floors**
- **1F** — Cosmetics/entrance, some mobile.
- **2F** — Mobile, computing.
- **3F** — Cameras (new: Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, OM System), lenses, action cams; small used section.
- **4F** — TV, audio, headphones.
- **5F–7F** — Household, toys, watches, games.
- **8F** — Tax-free counter, customer service.

**Hours:** 10:00–21:00 daily.

**Notes:** Best for new α6100/α6400 street prices and Bic's generous point-rebate (often 10–13%). Points can offset accessories. Less used stock than Map Camera or Yodobashi — visit here for new-gear price benchmarking and to spend earned points.
